clue.text: Nightspots' star performer is a card

definitions.meaning: the leading act among nightclubs, read whimsically as the top turn of all the clubs
one of the fifty-two in a pack, specifically the top one in the black suit with trefoil pips

explanation.surface: A nightclub headliner is described as a real character, a card.
explanation.definitionFit: Read playfully, the best performer among clubs is their ace; literally, it is a single playing card of that suit.

clue.text: Quickly grab biscuit, having got out of bed

parts.note: a ginger snap is a crisp biscuit, so a snap is a biscuit
someone who has risen for the day is up

explanation.surface: Someone hurriedly seizes a biscuit after rising in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb meaning to seize eagerly before anyone else can, as with a bargain.

clue.text: Class crossword compiler who gets stuff into print?

parts.note: a type is a class or kind
a setter is the person who composes a crossword

explanation.surface: A first-rate puzzle writer whose work reaches the printed page.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Class' looks like praise for the compiler but is a noun meaning kind. The question mark flags the definition as a description of a job rather than a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: A compositor arranges text or metal characters ready for printing, putting material into print.

clue.text: Look beyond page two

indicators.note: in this down clue the look comes beyond, after, the page

parts.note: an air is a look or manner, as in 'an air of confidence'

explanation.surface: An instruction to read past the second page of something.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple of things together form a set of two; the word is a direct synonym.

clue.text: King George meets European member of aristocracy in French city

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
a noble is a peer, one of the aristocracy

explanation.surface: A British king meets a continental aristocrat somewhere in France.
explanation.definitionFit: An Alpine city in south-eastern France, capital of the Isère department.

clue.text: Duty imposed on one vehicle

indicators.note: in this down clue the duty is placed on top of the numeral, sitting above it

parts.note: a duty is a tax levied by government
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A levy charged on a single car.
explanation.definitionFit: A hired car with a driver and meter is a kind of vehicle.

clue.text: Soundness of Tory PM holding line

indicators.note: the prime minister's name clasps the line letter within it

parts.note: Edward Heath was Conservative Prime Minister 1970-74

explanation.surface: Questioning how sound a Conservative leader is while he keeps to the party line.
explanation.definitionFit: Soundness of body or mind is wellbeing, freedom from illness.

clue.text: Yesteryear's vehicle could be creaking car, yeah?

indicators.note: the words creaking car yeah could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: Someone guesses that an old rattling car belongs to a bygone era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' signals that the letters of 'creaking car, yeah' can be rearranged into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse-drawn coach for hire, the old London cab, is a carriage of times past.

clue.text: Fish from Bali cooked in primitive building

indicators.note: the mixed letters sit in the middle of the shelter

parts.note: a hut is a simple, crude shelter

indicators.note: something cooked has been altered, so the letters of Bali are mixed up

explanation.surface: A fish from Bali is prepared in a rough shack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges BALI to ALIB, which goes 'in' HUT.
explanation.definitionFit: A large flatfish of northern seas, prized as food.

clue.text: Group of stars the French love

parts.note: le is the masculine French word for 'the'
love is nil in tennis, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: A constellation that the people of France adore.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lion is a zodiac constellation, a named group of stars.

clue.text: Quiet agent managed to phone up once before meal

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
a rep, a sales representative, acts as an agent
to run a business is to manage it
before keypads, calling someone meant turning a rotary dial

explanation.surface: A discreet agent had arranged to ring ahead of dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'once' marks the old-fashioned sense: calling someone used to mean using a rotary dial.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin-derived adjective describes something done or taken ahead of dinner, like an aperitif.

clue.text: 6 turned up in Lancashire town

indicators.note: turned means the word for the hired car is turned round

parts.note: the clue at 6-down defines a vehicle; here it is a cab
taken as written

explanation.surface: A hired car arrived in a northern English town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' reverses CAB, a synonym for the answer to 6-down, to give BAC.
explanation.definitionFit: A small former mill town in the Rossendale valley of north-west England.

clue.text: What about commotion with food being sent back in Mac's place?

indicators.note: the exclamation goes around the other letters

parts.note: eh? is an exclamation asking 'what?'
a din is a noisy commotion

indicators.note: being sent back means the slang word for food is read backwards

parts.note: grub is slang for food

explanation.surface: Someone complains of a fuss over a meal returned to the kitchen at a Scotsman's home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being sent back' gives BURG; 'about' wraps the exclamation round the rest. 'Mac' is a stock nickname for a Scotsman, so his place is the Scottish capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Scotland's capital is a fitting home for a typical Scotsman, nicknamed Mac.

clue.text: Like some swimsuits arriving undamaged?

definitions.meaning: describes a costume made as a single garment, not a bikini
describes something that reaches its destination whole and intact

explanation.surface: Swimwear that turns up without a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense describes a single-garment swimming costume; the idiom also means safe and intact.

clue.text: Impose restriction on friend in a reasonable manner

parts.note: to ration something is to limit how much of it is allowed
an ally is a friend or supporter

explanation.surface: Advice to curb a friend's behaviour in a sensible way.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with logic and sense is acting reasonably, the adverb matching the manner phrase.

clue.text: Proclaim President a monster on our screens

parts.note: Donald Trump, President of the United States
E.T. is the alien from Spielberg's film

explanation.surface: Declaring a head of state to be a television ogre.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'monster' is the friendly extra-terrestrial of the 1982 film, abbreviated ET.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce something loudly and boastfully, as with a fanfare, is to proclaim it.

clue.text: Pictures for official records

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
files are records kept officially

explanation.surface: Photographs kept for formal documentation.
explanation.definitionFit: Side-on portraits or outline drawings are pictures; also written sketches of a person.

clue.text: Be able to look down on public work

definitions.text: Be able to look down on

parts.note: overt means open, done in public view
op, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A building or project high enough to overlook its surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: To rise higher than something, so one can see down over it.

clue.text: Manufactured items the Queen gets crazy about

indicators.note: the slang word for crazy goes around the royal initials

parts.note: potty is British slang for crazy
ER, Elizabeth Regina, denotes the Queen

explanation.surface: The monarch becomes wildly enthusiastic about factory goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Ceramic ware such as pots and dishes is a class of goods made by hand or in factories.

clue.text: Conversation sure to ramble after party

indicators.note: the jumbled word comes after the dance party

parts.note: a disco is a dance party

indicators.note: to ramble is to wander aimlessly, so the letters of sure stray into a new order

explanation.surface: Talk certain to wander off course once the party is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' tempts as a political group, but here it is a night of dancing; 'ramble' makes URSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoken exchange or formal discussion between people is conversation.

clue.text: Entering sleazy bar, I had to be set apart

indicators.note: the contraction goes into the middle of the seedy venue

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable drinking place
I'd is the contraction of 'I had'

explanation.surface: Someone walked into a seedy bar and felt like an outsider.
explanation.definitionFit: To split or separate, so that parts become set apart from one another.

clue.text: Aussie animal's taking time to settle down

parts.note: roo is Australian slang for kangaroo; with the 's it gives roo's

explanation.surface: A kangaroo takes its time before resting.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds settle down for the night on a perch, which is the verb's meaning.

clue.text: Bolt's disappointing news about race's cancellation

definitions.meaning: to bolt is to flee suddenly
the announcement that the race won't happen, i.e. the run is off

explanation.surface: Usain Bolt hears the sad news that his race has been called off.
explanation.definitionFit: To flee is a phrasal verb meaning bolt; read as 'the run's off' it announces a scrapped race.

clue.text: V-sign shows support

parts.note: an indication is a sign or signal

explanation.surface: A rude two-fingered gesture is taken as a show of backing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'V-sign' is split: V stays as it is and 'sign' gives its synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Justification or proof of being right serves as support for a claim.

clue.text: Boy growing up beginning to enjoy organ

indicators.note: in a down clue, growing up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a son is a boy

indicators.note: beginning to means take the opening letter of enjoy

explanation.surface: A lad maturing starts to like playing the organ.
explanation.walkthrough: 'growing up' reverses SON to NOS; 'beginning to' takes E from 'enjoy'.
explanation.definitionFit: The facial organ of smell is a part of the body, a sense organ.

clue.text: Electrical units installed in campsite

indicators.note: installed in means the letters are set inside the word campsite

explanation.surface: Power supplies have been fitted at a camping ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Amperes measure electric current, and are standard electrical units.

clue.text: Period of anger when king is deposed

indicators.note: a deposed monarch is removed, so the king's letter is taken out

parts.note: rage is fierce anger
R, for Rex, denotes a king

explanation.surface: A time of public fury when the monarch is overthrown.
explanation.definitionFit: An era or epoch, a stretch of history, is a period.

clue.text: Scruples I deftly dealt with, showing no consideration for another

indicators.note: dealt with, like cards dealt out, means these letters are redistributed

explanation.surface: Someone skilfully disposed of their moral doubts and acted selfishly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dealt with' signals an anagram of 'Scruples I deftly'.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting rudely, without regard or respect for someone else.
